name: Skvader
description: The skvader is a Swedish fictional taxidermy creature combining the front half of a European hare with the back, wings, and tail of a female western capercaillie (wood grouse). It originated in a tall tale by Håkan Dahlmark and was constructed by taxidermist Rudolf Granberg in 1918.

aliases.name: Tetrao lepus pseudo-hybridus rarissimus
aliases.meaning: Mock scientific name given to the taxidermy specimen

origin: The skvader is a place-bound cultural artefact of the Medelpad province in central Sweden, with the original specimen on permanent display at the Norra Berget museum in Sundsvall.
